missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Поиск' is masculine nominative as the subject of 'продолжается'. 'Уже неделю' is the accusative duration phrase.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Поиск' is the accusative object of 'начала'; the inanimate masculine keeps the nominative form. 'Утром' gives the time.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'В поиске' uses the prepositional ending after 'в' to mean within the search. 'Этом' agrees in the masculine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'От поиска' takes the genitive after 'от' to mean from the search. 'Результата' is the genitive after 'не было'.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'От поиска' takes the genitive after 'от' to mean giving up the search. 'Ночью' is the instrumental time word.
Strategic focus: Accusative of direction. 'В поиск' uses the accusative after 'в' to show joining the search. 'Решения' is the genitive meaning of a solution.
Strategic focus: Dative after preposition. 'К поиску' uses the dative after 'к' to mean to the search. 'Волонтёров' is the animate accusative object brought in.
Strategic focus: Instrumental case. 'Поиском' is the instrumental required by 'занят' to mean busy with the search. 'Работы' is genitive meaning of work.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Поиски' is the nominative plural subject of 'длились'. 'Их' shows whose, and 'много дней' is the duration.
Strategic focus: Genitive plural after preposition. 'Поисков' is the genitive plural after 'после', and 'долгих' agrees in the genitive plural. The clause sums up their fatigue.
